case_number: CIVIL APPEAL NO. 1514 OF 2023 (Arising from S.L.P.(Civil) No. 32872/2018)

parties.respondent: State of Madhya Pradesh and Others

summary: Quotas exceeding 10% for limited departmental competitive examinations; compliance with All India Judges' Association directions; adjustment of surplus appointments to future recruitments; quo warranto relief inappropriate for quota enforcement; locus standi not adjudicated; excess appointments since 2007/2017 not quashed absent affected candidates.
legal_provisions_cited: All India Judges Association and Others v. Union of India and Others, (2010) 15 SCC 170
final_judgment: Appeal partly allowed; High Court directed to enforce 10% quota as per SC directions; surplus posts to be adjusted in future recruitments; no quashing of past excess appointments.
